p.title: Worker deploys stranded when main advances only by data-refresh commits
p.symptom: From 2026-10-07 13:54Z the live AI proxy stayed on v57.24 (source sha 11e7c0d) while worker/wrangler.proxy.toml said v57.27. Every Pages release verification after that (runs 161-169) failed on proxy-source-revision, and the Data freshness watchdog's only failing gate in its 2026-10-08T09:09Z run was external-pipeline. The Pages artifact itself was live and fresh (v57.27, data 37 minutes old); the red was a post-deploy plane check.
p.root_cause: Deploy AI proxy / Deploy fast data plane required the CI-attested SHA to equal main HEAD at decision time. The v57.27 merge push's CI finished after the refresh bot's next commit (2b7da10), so the run skipped every deploy step as stale (run 53, convergence decision skip). Bot commits are validated by workflow_dispatch CI runs created with GITHUB_TOKEN, which emit no workflow_run event (R606), and nothing dispatches the Worker workflows, so no later run re-evaluated the cumulative live-to-tested diff that already exists for this case.
p.fix: worker-deploy-impact.mjs: getMainAdvanceWorkerChanges classifies what a newer main changed; shouldDeployWorker accepts a newer main only when newerMainChanges[plane] === false and the tested SHA is its ancestor (unknown or throwing evidence fails closed), and a --main-advance CLI answers the same question for the pre-mutation guard. Both Worker workflows fetch the newer main, pass newerMainChanges into the convergence decision, and replace the exact-HEAD bash comparison in the guard with the CLI. The push-only CI provenance gate (R674) is unchanged.
p.violated_rule: P1351 intent: a delayed attested release must not overwrite newer Worker code. It does not require skipping a release when the newer commits leave the plane's deployment inputs byte-identical.
p.prevention: ci-cloudflare-deployment-contract-check P1351 assertions: data-only advance deploys, same-plane change stays a skip, other-plane change does not block, missing/empty evidence, non-descendant and git failure fail closed, manual redeploy follows the same rule, classifier edge cases, and both workflows fetch the newer main and use the shared classifier.
p.verification: Contract check and the cloudflare QA group pass; the new assertions fail on the pre-fix implementation. Replay on real history: tested d947723 with main at 2b7da10 or origin/main gives true for both planes; v57.24 to d947723 gives aiProxy=false (the merge changed worker/wrangler.proxy.toml) and a reversed pair gives false. Not verified: a live GitHub Actions run of the changed workflows, Cloudflare provisioning, and that the watchdog streak since 2026-09-26 had no other cause.

r.title: A newer main is stale for a Worker plane only when it changes that plane's deployment inputs
r.rule: Worker deploy workflows judge a newer main per plane: equal to the tested SHA, or a descendant whose diff leaves the plane's deployment inputs untouched. Missing evidence, a non-descendant, or a git error means stale. Both the convergence decision and the pre-mutation guard use the shared classifier; the guard has no unconditional safe output.

changelog: **Worker 배포 정체 해소 (P{P}/R{R}):** 데이터 갱신 봇 커밋만 앞서 나간 main은 Worker 입력을 바꾸지 않으면 stale로 보지 않도록 배포 판정과 직전 가드를 통일. 10/7 이후 Pages 배포 후 검증이 프록시 리비전 불일치로 연속 실패하던 원인.
